notes: The Rust EXPLICIT_UNSUPPORTED_CLI_SURFACES and ADDITIONAL_UNSUPPORTED_CLI_SURFACES registries are authoritative. Every unsupported entry returns a machine-visible hard error; unregistered command strings are rejected at runtime. Parser presence, a marker file, or a generated service template is not treated as implementation. Additional surface notes: exec --device never falls back to local; session open <device> never falls back to local; privileged broker install/uninstall are side-effect-free unsupported operations (no templates, markers, or process spawns) until a secure mint authority exists; privileged broker status reports fail-closed metadata only. Update surfaces are production-wired against official GitHub Releases with embedded minisign verification; automatic network checks remain off by default.
